ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer and its affiliates upon written notice a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, transferable by Customer to its successor in an M&A transaction, without right of sublicense, license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Auction Platform licence to our affiliates upon written notice, made it transferable by Customer to its successor in an M&A transaction, and deleted the at-will "revocable" operator. This is our fallback position; a licence revocable at Kubient's discretion with no path to add affiliates is not acceptable.
proposal.summary: Cover AP affiliates on written notice, permit Customer transfer to its M&A successor, and delete at-will revocability

mappings.element: Licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
